providers.pricingNotes: Pro, iad1: active CPU $0.128 per vCPU-hour of CPU time (I/O wait not billed), memory $0.0212 per GB-hour of wall time in one-minute minimum increments, $0.60 per million creations. Vercel's docs leave rounding after the first minute open; we charge whole minutes, the dearer reading. Metered: the bench stops each sandbox to read Vercel's meter before deleting it, so the meter includes the stop's disk snapshot (about 3% in one probe; approximate, not corrected per task). Hourly assumes every vCPU busy. Pro's $20 credit, data transfer and snapshot storage excluded.

providers.pricingNotes: Sandbox rates ($0.1419 per CPU-hour, $0.024 per GiB-hour; one Modal CPU is a physical core). Billed per second on max(request, usage), minimum request 0.125 CPU. Priced on the requested allocation, never on the guest's MemTotal, which shows the host's memory without a size. A sized sandbox pins request = limit, so its estimate is exact. The default track (0.125 CPU, 128 MiB request) bursts into spare host capacity and that usage is billed too, so its estimate is a lower bound. A pinned region adds 1.15x (broad, such as us) or 1.75x (narrow, such as us-east). No disk charge or creation fee listed; plan credits excluded.
